services.name: General Consultation
services.shortDescription: An unhurried first conversation about whatever is on your mind, from new symptoms to ongoing questions.
services.description: A general consultation is the simplest way to start. You sit down with a doctor, talk through what you have noticed, and leave with a clear sense of what comes next. We keep these visits unhurried so there is time for proper listening, a careful examination when needed, and plain-language explanations.
includes: Conversation about your concerns and history
Clear next steps and written visit notes
Referral guidance if specialist input would help

faqs.a: Bring a list of current medications, any recent test results, and a short note about when your symptoms started. That is plenty.
Only if they would genuinely change the plan. Your doctor will explain why a test is suggested and what it would answer.

services.name: Dental Care
services.shortDescription: Routine checkups, cleaning, and practical advice that keeps everyday dental care calm and predictable.
services.description: Our dental visits focus on prevention and comfort. Expect a careful check of teeth and gums, gentle cleaning where needed, and honest guidance about treatment options. We explain costs before anything begins and never rush decisions.

faqs.q: I feel nervous about dental visits. Is that okay?
faqs.a: Completely. Tell us when you book and we will allow extra time, explain each step, and pause whenever you need.
Yes, routine dental reviews are suitable for school-age children. For very young children, call us and we will advise.

services.name: Pediatrics
services.shortDescription: Friendly, unhurried appointments for babies, children, and teens, with time for parents to ask everything.
services.description: Children need a slower pace and a room that does not feel intimidating. Pediatric visits give time for gentle examination, growth and development review, vaccination planning, and plenty of space for parents to ask questions.
includes: Gentle examination at your child's pace

faqs.a: Yes. There is room for two caregivers, and siblings are welcome to sit in quietly.

faqs.q: What if my child is unwell on the day?
faqs.a: Call us before you travel. We will advise whether to keep the visit, adjust the time, or arrange a different kind of review.

services.name: Dermatology
services.shortDescription: Help with acne, eczema, rashes, and mole checks, plus honest advice on everyday skin care.
services.description: Dermatology visits take skin concerns seriously without overcomplicating them. Your doctor examines the affected areas, uses dermoscopy where it helps, and builds a treatment plan around products and habits you can realistically maintain.
includes: Focused review of your skin concerns
Clear guidance on what to watch for

faqs.q: Should I arrive with clean skin?
faqs.a: Please avoid heavy makeup or self-tanner on the areas you want reviewed, so nothing is hidden.
This is a medical dermatology visit. We will give honest guidance and point you in the right direction if you want cosmetic options.

services.name: Gynecology
services.shortDescription: Private consultations for cycle concerns, contraception, screening reviews, and midlife changes.
services.description: Gynecology visits are private and unhurried. Common reasons to book include cycle or pain concerns, contraception conversations, routine screening reviews, and perimenopause support. You set the pace, and nothing proceeds without your consent.
includes: Private consultation in a quiet room
Symptom discussion, examination only with consent

faqs.a: Only if it is needed and you agree to it. Many concerns can be discussed first, and you can decline or pause at any point.
Yes. What you discuss stays between you and your care team, within standard medical confidentiality.

services.name: Urology
services.shortDescription: Respectful care for urinary and male health concerns, with clear explanations at every step.
services.description: Urology visits deal with sensitive topics in a matter-of-fact, respectful way. Expect a thorough conversation about symptoms and history, examination only with your consent, and a plain explanation of what the findings mean for you.
includes: Private discussion of symptoms and history
Clear next steps and referrals if needed

faqs.q: What happens at a first urology visit?
faqs.a: Mostly talking. Your doctor reviews your symptoms and history, and any examination is explained first and done only with consent.

faqs.q: Do I need a referral to book?
faqs.a: No referral is needed. Book directly and bring any prior test results if you have them.

services.name: Cardiology Screening
services.shortDescription: Heart health screening with blood pressure, ECG review, and a practical prevention plan.
services.description: This screening visit looks at where your heart health stands today and what would lower your risk tomorrow. It covers blood pressure, an ECG where appropriate, and a review of lifestyle and family factors, ending with a prevention plan built around your daily life.
includes: Risk factor and family history review

faqs.q: Do I need to fast or prepare?
faqs.a: No special preparation is needed. Take your usual medications and bring a list of them.
Your doctor will explain the finding in plain words and arrange the right follow-up or referral without delay.

services.name: Physical Therapy
services.shortDescription: Hands-on rehabilitation for back pain, sports injuries, and recovery after surgery.
services.description: Physical therapy sessions start with how you move, not just where it hurts. Your therapist assesses movement and strength, treats what is treatable in the room, and sends you home with exercises that fit into a normal week.

faqs.a: Comfortable clothing you can move in. Shorts are helpful for knee or hip concerns.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: It depends on the condition. Your therapist reassesses progress each visit and will tell you honestly when you are ready to continue on your own.

services.name: Vaccination and Wellness
services.shortDescription: Routine immunizations and wellness advice for children and adults, in one short visit.
services.description: A short, practical visit for staying up to date. We review which vaccines you or your child are due, administer them safely, and cover the small wellness habits that keep everyday health on track.
includes: Review of due and recommended vaccines

faqs.a: Routine childhood immunizations and common adult boosters. We confirm eligibility when you book so nothing is wasted.
Mild soreness or tiredness for a day is common. We explain what to expect and what signs merit a call.

doctors.bio: Dr. Osei enjoys the detective work of general practice. She is known for listening carefully, explaining options in plain language, and making sure patients leave knowing exactly what happens next.

doctors.bio: Dr. Reyes believes dental visits should feel calm and predictable. His appointments include time for questions, clear cost explanations, and a prevention plan that fits real life.
doctors.slotsNote: Available Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday mornings.

doctors.name: Dr. Maya Lindqvist
doctors.bio: Dr. Lindqvist works at a child's pace. Parents appreciate her warm manner, her patience with nervous little patients, and the clear written summaries she sends home.
doctors.slotsNote: Available Monday and Wednesday through Friday.

doctors.name: Dr. Sofia Marchetti
doctors.bio: Dr. Marchetti provides private, respectful gynecological care. Patients value her straightforward explanations and the way she lets each person set the pace of the visit.
doctors.slotsNote: Available Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday mornings.

doctors.name: Dr. Jonas Weber
doctors.bio: Dr. Weber looks after many of the clinic's returning patients. He is organized, thorough with follow-ups, and good at turning complicated results into a simple plan.

doctors.name: Dr. Lena Hoffmann
doctors.bio: Dr. Hoffmann focuses on everyday skin concerns, from acne and eczema to mole checks. She explains treatment options clearly and favors simple routines patients can maintain.

doctors.name: Dr. Marcus Reid
doctors.bio: Dr. Reid provides straightforward urology care in a private setting. Patients appreciate his direct explanations and his unhurried approach to sensitive concerns.

doctors.name: Dr. Elena Vargas
doctors.bio: Dr. Vargas specializes in heart health screening and prevention. Her visits turn test results into a practical plan built around each patient's daily life.

doctors.name: Dr. Tomas Silva
doctors.bio: Dr. Silva designs recovery programs for back pain, sports injuries, and post-surgical rehabilitation. His sessions are encouraging, hands-on, and paced to each patient.
